result.title: WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions
result.summary: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.

AI.brief_summary: WorldInteract 将跨材质交互分解为材质相关行为生成与接触响应计算，用共享的速度增量接口把物理控制器与因果流式生成器连接，并以物理可验证奖励的强化学习训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「外部状态增量接口注入生成过程」与「可验证物理奖励」可能为 LVR 中如何把视觉证据增量写入 latent 状态、以及用可验证奖励监督推理轨迹提供线索，需核查其因果流式状态是否具备可复用的模块化结构。
